title: Java Full Stack Developer
description:

Skill 1 – Yrs of Exp – Java Full stack

Skill 2 – Yrs of Exp – Angular

Skill 3 – Yrs of Exp – Microservices

Good To have Skills –

title: AS400 Developer
description:
Role: AS/400 Developer
Location: Issaquah, WA - 5D Onsite
Duration: 6-12+ Months Contract

Mandatory Areas

Must Have Skills
Skill 1 – Understanding of X12 and EDIFACT standards, mapping, and development of EDI transactions.
Skill 2 – Excellent programming skills on the iSeries platform – Analyze and Create new programs using RPG, RPG ILE, SQLRPGLE, and Control Language (CLP/CLLE).
Skill 3 – Understanding of canonical data models for EDI transactions

The opportunity:
• Analyzes and develops iSeries code that supports various applications in the Retail Domain.
• Creates functional specifications for applications supported using standard practices, processes, and procedures.
• Performs code reviews, unit testing, coordinates with development team members on development, and QA tasks.
• Adheres to the client's IS division development standards and deployment processes and procedures.
• Collaborates with the Product Owner, business area, team members, and QA to ensure requirements are clearly defined, understood, and documented.
• Participates in development estimation, deployment, and release planning to ensure delivery of solutions.

Must-Have:
• Understanding of X12 and EDIFACT standards, mapping, and development of EDI transactions.
• Excellent programming skills on the iSeries platform – Analyze and Create new programs using RPG, RPG ILE, SQLRPGLE, and Control Language (CLP/CLLE).
• Very good knowledge of SQL concepts – Analyze and modify complex SQL queries, embedded SQL in SQLRPGLE, Cursor programming, SQL Sprocs.
• Database Concepts – Create and Analyze Physical files, Logical Files, SQL tables, Indexes, Views, Stored procedures.
• Good working knowledge in screen programming – Display Files, Subfiles, and Printer files.
• Understanding of canonical data models for EDI transactions.
• Experience with job schedulers; such as Robot, AJS, and UC4.
• Basic Linux command line experience
• ILE Programming – Analyze and Create program modules, binding directories, service programs.
• Working knowledge of Message Queue (MQ), MQ Trigger, and embedding XML tags in RPG Programs
• Good communication skills and the job will involve owning a project task completely based on the communication with the analysts at the client site

Good to Have:
• Good working knowledge in Turnover – the code configuration management tool
• Good working knowledge in X- Analysis – cross-reference tool for iSeries.
• Knowledge of Triggers, Message Queuing for inter-program/ inter-system communication
• ROBOT job scheduler – knowledge in creating and setting up scheduled jobs in the iSeries.
• Knowledge of normalized, denormalized tables, Star Schema databases
• Working knowledge on iSeries Navigator – to run queries and analyze the performance of SQL queries.
Knowledge in the Retail Domain especially in areas like Merchandising, Warehouse Management, Distribution,etc.

title: GCP Data Modeler
description:
Role: Data Modeler
Location: Issaquah, WA - 3D Onsite
Duration: 6-12+ Months Contract

Note: We are looking for GCP Data Modeler.

Must Have Skills – Data Modeler
Skill 1 – 8 + Years of exp in Data Modeling
Skill 2 – 3 + Years of Exp in GCP
Skill 3- 6+ Years In Erwin, Snowflake, Python, Snowflake, Azure Synapse

Key Responsibilities:

• Retail Data Modeling: Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for retail systems including POS, inventory, CRM, and e-commerce platforms.
• Reverse Engineering: Analyze and reverse engineer existing table structures from legacy systems to understand data relationships and dependencies.
• Data Migration Mapping: Build comprehensive mapping documents to support one-time data loads from legacy systems into modern data platforms.
• SQL Development: Write and optimize complex SQL queries for data profiling, transformation, validation, and reporting. Strong SQL skills are a critical requirement for this role.
• Customer & Product Analytics: Develop models that support customer segmentation, product performance tracking, and personalized marketing.
• Collaboration: Work with data engineers, business analysts, and merchandising teams to translate retail business needs into scalable data solutions.
• ETL & Integration: Develop and optimize ETL pipelines for integrating data from retail systems (e.g., ERP, WMS, loyalty platforms) using tools like Talend, SSIS, or Azure Data Factory.
• Data Warehousing: Architect retail data warehouses and data lakes to support reporting and advanced analytics.
• Governance & Quality: Ensure data models adhere to governance standards and support high data quality across retail domains.
• Documentation: Maintain metadata repositories and document data lineage, definitions, and usage across retail systems.
• Performance Monitoring: Monitor and tune data models for performance, especially for high-volume retail transactions and real-time analytics.
• Identifies ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality of data management. Communicates technical concepts to non-technical audiences both written and verbal.

Mandatory Skills:
Data Modeling, Erwin, Snowflake, Python, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Experience with cloud platform(Azure, GCP)

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
• 7+ years of experience in data modeling, preferably in the retail industry.
• Expert-level SQL query development and optimization experience.
• Proficiency in Python and data modeling tools like Erwin or ER/Studio.
• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, and GCP) and retail data solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse).
• Strong understanding of OLTP and OLAP systems in a retail context.
• Familiarity with retail KPIs such as sell-through rate, inventory turnover, and customer lifetime value.


Preferred Skills:

• Experience with retail analytics platforms (e.g., SAS Retail, Oracle Retail, SAP CAR).
• Knowledge of retail compliance standards (e.g., PCI DSS).
• Certification in cloud data services or retail analytics tools.
• Exposure to AI/ML use cases in retail such as demand forecasting and recommendation engines.
